Since 1971, Averitt has helped businesses move freight and strengthen supply chains through a complete range of transportation and logistics solutions. From LTL and Truckload to Dedicated, Distribution & Fulfillment, and Integrated services, we make it easy to find everything you need under one roof. The Power of One.
 
Our network of 100+ facilities and thousands of associates keeps freight moving reliably across North America. We’re driven by a simple idea: combine trusted service with forward-thinking technology and sustainability to make logistics work smarter for everyone.
 
At Averitt, we don’t just move shipments, we build lasting partnerships that help our customers grow.
